<thought>Based on the observed monoisotopic [M+H]⁺ peak at m/z 194.0862, the neutral molecular mass is ≈193.079 Da. Considering typical isotopic patterns (≈13 % M+1 suggests ~10 carbons) and fitting integer combinations of C, H, O, and one nitrogen, the formula C₁₀H₁₁NO₃ matches the mass within a few millidaltons and explains the isotopic intensity. Therefore the molecular formula is C10H11O3N.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H11O3N</final_answer>
